A rare genetic mutation called pseudo-melanism has resulted in roughly half of the tigers in India's Similipal Tiger Reserve sporting coats with far more black than those of usual tigers. This widespread coloration is a symptom of a shallow gene pool in a region that previously faced a dwindling tiger population, and could prove catastrophic if conservation officers aren't able to find these tigers more genetically diverse mates. The long wait is over for seven tigers.  8 years after Guatemala banned animal circuses  and ADI emptied the cages, the last circus tigers whose rescue was blocked are on their way to freedom.  The government departments of UBA and CONAP fought to save the animals and ADI never gave up on them.  Circo Rey Gitano denied them eight years of freedom keeping them shut in cages on trucks.  Now ADI urgently needs your support to bring them home to the ADI Wildlife Sanctuary.  We have kept this operation secret until the tigers were safe.  Please help. Support the rescue!
